scope: Independent lifecycle review of focused leads C/D, adjacent JSONL admission/drain, and pre-existing HTTP delivery changes. Existing dirty work was retained; no historical receipt or AGENTS.md changed.

C.disposition: already addressed in HEAD, freshly verified
C.evidence: Health register deletes name cache and disposer checks record identity; final cache insertion retains record identity guard. Three tests cover metadata/critical replacement, ordinary readiness, old/new disposers, unregister and delayed old callback.

D.disposition: already addressed in HEAD, freshly verified; adjacent defects confirmed and repaired
D.evidence: Admitted exports are tracked before yielding; close aborts active requests and retries, all compression/split/request continuations check lifecycle, closes agent and waits admitted exports. Six tests cover standalone and runtime-owned shutdown plus ordinary pre-close retries.

JSONL.disposition: already addressed in HEAD, freshly verified
JSONL.evidence: writeMany registers full operation before initialization; close closes admission synchronously and drains pendingWrites across kinds. Two tests cover deferred initialization, flush, repeated close, late admission rejection and persisted accepted records.

newDefects.issue: Truncated acknowledgement automatically repeats accepted telemetry
newDefects.reproduction: Loopback receiver reads full request then sends partial response body with longer content-length and closes. Before fix error.retryable was true; after fix false with details.delivery unknown and one received request.
newDefects.fix: Response aborted/error paths use uncertainty wrapper preserving error code and disabling automatic replay.

newDefects.issue: Connection reset after full payload send automatically repeats accepted telemetry
newDefects.reproduction: Loopback receiver reads full request then destroys socket before sending response. Before fix retryable undefined permits retries; after fix ECONNRESET retained, retryable false, details.delivery unknown, one received request.
newDefects.fix: Transport error after ClientRequest.writableFinished is treated as unknown delivery.

newDefects.issue: Socket inactivity timeout allows unbounded elapsed request with trickling response
newDefects.reproduction: Loopback response sends bytes every 20ms for 400ms with exporter timeoutMs 100. Before fix export completed successfully after 417.5ms; after fix rejects MONITOR_EXPORT_TIMEOUT after 102.0ms, before planned response completion.
newDefects.fix: Owned per-attempt elapsed deadline replaces socket inactivity timer; clears at every settlement. Covers socket queue wait and response duration.

commands.failure: All 8 network tests failed listen EPERM 127.0.0.1; no assertion failures in non-network checks. Retried with required escalation.

compatibility: Public exports and signatures unchanged. timeoutMs now bounds each request attempt, including socket queue wait and trickling response; it does not bound aggregate serialization/compression/chunks/retries. Complete explicit 503/429 responses retain ordinary bounded retry semantics. Uncertain transport acknowledgements do not automatically replay; this can reduce automatic recovery and avoids silently duplicating accepted telemetry. No claim of remote durable persistence or undo on close.
limits: No live exporters or production destinations were used.
Injected callback or filesystem work may remain physically active if non-cooperative; these tests concern owned continuations and task-owned loopback connections.
No exact-final-artifact result is implied by this native source receipt; parent task performs fresh distribution gates.
